name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 120 – Am 39
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 120a. Calls for an assessment of the feasibility of introducing a harmonised mechanism for taxing exceptional profits in the energy sector as a potential new own resource, provided that the resulting revenues are used to alleviate energy costs for households and SMEs and to advance the Union’s objectives on renewable energy and energy transition;
